answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The horizon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the fable is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
